scope: Bounded static UI/state integration review of five frozen files; independent Core adversarial coverage owned by ending agent. No GUI click or screenshot claim.

checks.subject: per-system controls
checks.finding: Count steppers bind only systemStaffCounts, range 1...4, disabled for unchecked parts. Expected selection uses that dictionary with the profile default as fallback; profile.parts is never mutated by these controls.

checks.subject: Load
checks.finding: Actual saved candidateIDs determine music staff counts. Rest bands do not enter the printed roster. Existing start/count values load separately.

checks.subject: Show
checks.finding: Same-page selection immediately transfers exact suggestion counts. Cross-page Show saves a pending suggestion, updates the page image/clears previous selection, then calls the same selection function through onChange; it does not reset the transferred counts afterward.

checks.subject: single assignment
checks.finding: Only checked part counts pass to assign; local grouping persists for the next system. Measure counts clear after each assignment and are not inherited from a template.

checks.subject: batch assignment
checks.finding: Each displayed suggestion names its own counts and the exact dictionary passes into ScoreSystemAssignmentChoice. Competing suggestions for one physical system remain unchecked, and checking one removes its siblings.

checks.subject: async state
checks.finding: Still-matching guard includes source bytes, analyses, rectifications, selected pages, exclusions, profile and overrides. A stale result cannot publish/apply; run identity and cancellation gates remain unchanged.

checks.subject: profile scope
checks.finding: Core assign/batch only use per-system values to partition selected staff IDs; saved global staffCount values remain exact. New Auto resets local count state.

limitations: Actual SwiftUI rendering/accessibility interaction is not exercised here.
Physical system identity remains user-reviewed; this change does not recognize divisi from staff count.
Persistence test follows existing candidateIDs override format rather than inventing a new profile field.
